Orc & Goblin Tribes Talisman. The creature gains the listed battlefield benefit while the conditions in this feature are met. If the feature calls for a saving throw, use the dynamic DC recorded in the item data; if it grants an aura, only chosen allies inside the stated range benefit.

This discipline is learned in mud, ash, and shouted command. It changes how the warrior occupies the field: where allies stand firmer, enemies hesitate, and a single heartbeat of motion becomes the difference between slaughter and survival.

“Hit ’em hard enough and the plan sorts itself out.”
— an Orc boss

source.book: Warhammer: The Old World x D&D 5e
